review:
Quick, punchy classic slot with a Hold and Spin bonus and five fixed jackpots: Mini (25x), Minor (50x), Major (100x), Mega (1,000x) and Grand (5,000x). Three Blazing Firepot symbols trigger it.

The Respin Ante adds 40% to your bet to make the bonus come 50% faster: land two firepots and you get a respin with only firepots active. Everything's tuned for fast rounds and frequent features, like a land-based jackpot machine. Medium-high volatility, 5,000x max, 96.27% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
